description: Sets the user's selection of countries on a country review. On a validation review (type ENTRY_PLAN_VALIDATION) these are the countries a European patent is to be validated in, as two-letter EPC state codes or UP for the Unitary Patent. On a regional entry review (type ENTRY_PLAN_REGIONAL) they are the countries and regional offices a priority or PCT application is to be entered in, as two-letter office codes such as US, EP for the European Patent Office, or WO for the PCT route from a priority application. Replaces the whole selection; get_review shows the recommended and currently selected countries, and lists the codes this review accepts in validation.available. Only a reviewer who has not yet approved, or a specialist, may change it while the review is open; a change sends earlier approvals back to pending. The review is then approved with respond_to_review.

countries.description: The countries to select, as two-letter codes the review accepts (UP for the Unitary Patent on a validation review, WO for the PCT route on a regional entry review)

name: set_validation_countries
title: Set validation countries in Lightbringer
